## Hinge question {#dc4-hinge .dc-lesson }

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">For <span data-math="y=e^{2x}\sin x"></span>, which expression is <span data-math="\frac{dy}{dx}"></span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="2e^{2x}\cos x"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="e^{2x}(\sin x+\cos x)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="e^{2x}(2\sin x+\cos x)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="e^{2x}(2\sin x-\cos x)"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="2e^{2x}\sin x+e^{2x}\cos x"></span>. The product rule gives two terms; the chain rule supplies the factor 2.</div></div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic. Correct choice 3: differentiate the exponential factor and leave sine, then leave the exponential factor and differentiate sine: y'=2e^(2x)sin x+e^(2x)cos x. Choice 1 multiplies the derivatives, instead of using the product rule. Choice 2 omits the chain-rule factor 2. Choice 4 incorrectly differentiates sin x to -cos x. All choices are expressions for a derivative function, so equality at isolated x-values does not make another option correct.

Use the shared 60-second timer, adjustable duration, Start/Pause/Resume and Reset; answer remains hidden at expiry. Fist on chest, think quietly, then show 1–4 fingers simultaneously on the teacher's cue. Ready: continue to Example 4.1. Divided: ask pairs to explain where both terms come from, then revote. Needs explanation: label u=e^(2x), v=sin x and identify u', v' separately; substitute in u'v+uv', then retry. About three minutes.
:::
